Name: Dryads of the Valley for Alternative Textures
Author: breeshlean
Description:
[u][b]DESCRIPTION
[/b][/u]
Updated for SDV 1.6

The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/986?tab=description]Dryads of the Valley[/url] has been updated and expanded.  In addition to the new Dryads for the Mango and Banana Trees, there are recolors for some of the originals.  DotV now uses Alternative Textures.  This means that each[color=#ff0000] fruit tree [/color]can have a different look.  Maybe some will be dryads and others not.  It's up to you. 


[u][b]INITIAL USE

[/b][/u]1) This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures.[/url]  Install these first.

2) Unzip this mod's files into the Mods folder. 

[u][b]UPDATES

[/b][/u]When updating this mod, delete the previous version from your Mods folder and drop in the new version.

[u][b]COMPATIBILITY
[/b][/u]
I run a wide variety of mods and have found no compatibility issues with them, except for Content Patcher mods that recolor fruit trees.  Alternative Textures overrides Content Patcher recolors.  That is not something that I can control.
